mainEntity.name: What kind of content is best for AEO for a roofing contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a roofing contractor, the best content for AEO focuses on demonstrating expertise, addressing customer pain points, and showcasing local relevance. This includes detailed blog posts about common roofing problems and solutions, explanations of different roofing materials and their benefits, and guides on roof maintenance. Case studies of local projects with before-and-after photos, customer testimonials, and videos demonstrating installation processes or common repairs are also highly effective. Such content establishes the contractor as an authoritative resource and helps build trust with potential clients.
acceptedAnswer.description: Best AEO content for roofing contractors includes detailed guides on problems/solutions, material explanations, maintenance tips, local project case studies, testimonials, and process videos.
